name: HTML
description: The standard markup language used to structure content and build the foundation of web pages.

name: CSS
description: A stylesheet language used to design layouts, colors, spacing, animations, and responsive web interfaces.

name: JavaScript
description: A versatile programming language that adds dynamic behavior and interactive functionality to web applications.

name: React
description: A component-based JavaScript library for building interactive and scalable user interfaces.

name: TypeScript
description: A typed superset of JavaScript that helps developers build more reliable and maintainable applications.

name: Tailwind CSS
description: A utility-first CSS framework for rapidly creating responsive and customizable user interfaces.

name: Node.js
description: A JavaScript runtime that allows developers to build fast and scalable server-side applications.

name: Express.js
description: A lightweight Node.js framework for building web servers, REST APIs, routes, and backend applications.

name: MongoDB
description: A document-oriented NoSQL database designed for flexible data storage and scalable applications.

name: Git
description: A distributed version control system used to track code changes and manage development workflows.

name: GitHub
description: A platform for hosting Git repositories, collaborating with developers, and managing software projects.

name: Docker
description: A containerization platform that packages applications and their dependencies for consistent deployment.
